meta.title: Grid Systems — studio credentials for Nordhavn Transit
meta.description: Credentials deck for Grid Systems, a Zürich and New York brand-systems studio: point of view, principles, three measured cases, clients, a client voice, the six-week sprint and a first-sprint proposal for Nordhavn Transit.

slides.eyebrow: Grid Systems · Zürich / New York · For Nordhavn Transit
slides.heading: Brand systems that survive engineering, not just the launch.
slides.notes: Introduce the two partners by name, then go straight to the work.

slides.heading: We draw the grid first, and the logo falls out of it
slides.lead: Columns, baseline and four type sizes come before any mark.

slides.heading: Three rules keep a brand intact after 300 people touch it
Three cases, each with a measured result
Rhine Rail's new signs cut wrong-platform boardings by 38%
slides.lead: One sign grammar for 212 stations in three languages.

slides.heading: Rhine Rail rolled the system out to 212 stations in 14 months
Atelier Nord's hand-off time fell from three weeks to four days

slides.heading: Who we have built systems for

slides.quote: They gave us a system, not a moodboard. Two years on, our engineers still ship with it.
slides.by: Elena Vogt · Design Director, Atelier Nord

slides.heading: A six-week sprint takes a brand from audit to production kit
Nordhavn's first sprint would rebuild 40 station signs and one timetable
slides.body: We start where riders get lost most: the four interchange stations.
